alt: Title panel on black. Small white handwritten caption at the top gives way to huge hand-lettered words: WEIGHT in magenta, HEALTH in blue, and APPEARANCE reversed out of a magenta ribbon banner across the bottom. A woman in glasses with short hair, drawn in white outline only, stands with her arms folded in front of the lettering.
text: IT'S IMPOSSIBLE TO LIVE IN THIS WORLD AS A WOMAN, ESPECIALLY AROUND NEW YEARS, AND NOT BE BOMBARDED WITH MESSAGES ABOUT WEIGHT, HEALTH, AND APPEARANCE.

alt: A large blue speech balloon fills most of the black panel, its hand-lettered white text sized up on the key words. At the right edge the woman in glasses stands on a bathroom scale in a sleeveless dress, one hand on her hip, scowling down, drawn in white outline.
text: THE LOUDEST VOICES SAY: YOU MUST BE THIN, PRETTY and DELICATE. YOU MUST BE SMALL TO BE LOVED.

alt: A big magenta speech balloon with motion lines around it takes up the panel, its hand-lettered text mixing white and black words. At the lower left the woman in glasses, in white outline, holds a small apple in both hands and looks down at it with a flat expression.
text: ...BUT OTHER VOICES SAY THE OPPOSITE. GOING ON A DIET OR TRYING TO LOSE WEIGHT FOR ANY REASON IS APPEASING THE PATRIARCHY.

alt: The woman in glasses is drawn from the chest up in white outline, arms spread wide as if wading, surrounded and half-submerged by a dense crowd of overlapping blue and magenta speech balloons that run off all four edges of the black panel. The balloons carry contradictory diet and body messages, several cropped by the panel edge.
text: GOING OUTSIDE OR ONLINE IS LIKE WADING THROUGH A SEA OF OTHER PEOPLES' OPINIONS ON WEIGHT... / DO YOU REALLY WANT TO BE THAT GIRL WHO DOESN'T EAT FREE CAKE? / LOSING WEIGHT WILL GIVE YOU MORE ENERGY / IT'S OKAY TO WANT TO LOSE WEIGHT IF IT'S FOR YOUR HEALTH / COUCH TO 5K / *NEW YEAR, NEW YOU* / KETO / THIS STORE DOESN'T CARRY YOUR DRESS SIZE / DIETS NEVER WORK / EVERY WOMAN WANTS TO LOSE TEN POUNDS / WHY YOU SHOULD CUT ALL CARBS / CLICK HERE FOR ONE WEIRD TRICK TO LOSE BELLY FLAB / COUNT CALORIES / WHY YOU DEFINITELY SHOULDN'T CUT ALL CARBS

alt: The woman lies in bed in profile, eyes closed, one arm raised so she can look at her smartwatch, all drawn in white outline on black. Dimmed, half-faded blue and magenta speech balloons float around and behind her head and body, their lettering grey and receding; a small bright magenta balloon points out of the watch face.
text: ...AND THOSE VOICES ECHO THROUGH MY HEAD AND BODY EVEN WHEN I'M TRYING TO SLEEP. / LOSING WEIGHT WILL MAKE IT EASIER TO FIND LOVE / CLOSE YOUR MOVE RING / JUST EAT LESS AND EXERCISE MORE

alt: The woman walks inside a large chalky circle, reaching up to draw its white rim with a piece of chalk, in white outline on black. Outside the circle, solid blue and magenta teardrop shapes fall like rain on all sides but cannot get in. Caption text runs above and below the circle; the first letter of the top line is cut off by the panel edge.
text: N 2018, I DREW A SOUNDPROOF BARRIER AROUND MYSELF. / I HAD IMPORTANT QUESTIONS FOR MY BODY AND THE ANSWERS WERE HARD TO HEAR.

alt: A chalk-textured dark circle sits centred on black, its two questions hand-lettered in white curving around the inside of the rim. Within it the woman in glasses stands alone in a V-neck sweater, arms folded across her stomach, looking down.
text: I ASKED MY BODY: WHAT DO YOU WANT? WHAT DO YOU NEED?

alt: Inside a chalky dark circle the woman sits cross-legged with eyes closed and hair floating outward, drawn in white outline. Short quoted phrases are lettered directly onto her body: across her chest, along her forearm, on her hand, and on her knee. A caption runs above the circle and a note in magenta and white runs along a torn white strip at the bottom.
text: I HEARD A RESPONSE: MY BODY WANTED MORE ACTIVITY, NOT SO MUCH JUNK FOOD, AND TO BE APPRECIATED HERE AND NOW. / "PLEASE EAT HEALTHIER FOOD" / "LOVE ME NOW" / "EXPLORE JOGGING" / "SLEEP" / IMPORTANT NOTE: WHAT I HEARD IS NOT PRESCRIPTIVE FOR OTHERS, EVERY BODY IS DIFFERENT.

alt: The woman's head and shoulders are drawn in white outline low in the black panel, eyes rolled sideways and mouth tight, hemmed in on every side by five pointed blue and magenta speech balloons that crowd against her face.
text: IT'S THE NEW YEAR AGAIN AND THE OUTSIDE VOICES ARE UP TO FULL BLAST. / 12 BEST SUPERFOODS FOR WEIGHT LOSS, RANKED! / TRIM YOUR TUMMY / 2019: LOW SUGAR OR LOW FAT? / EVERYTHING IN MODERATION / 80/20

alt: The woman in glasses holds up an open umbrella, drawn in white outline on black, with a small closed-mouth smile. Solid blue and magenta teardrops fall at an angle from the upper left and are stopped by the canopy. A three-line caption sits above and a four-line caption at the lower left.
text: BUT MY RESOLUTION IN 2019 IS TO KEEP FINDING QUIET SPACES TO ASK MY BODY: "WHAT DO YOU WANT? WHAT DO YOU NEED?" / AND LEARN TO HEAR MY OWN INNER VOICE ABOVE THE DIN.
